subject: stable versus testing install on R Windows 3.5.3

messages.author: 5063972801d34964
messages.subject: stable versus testing install on R Windows 3.5.3
parts:
When I download the current stable version of INLA using the instructions on the website, I get errors:

 

Loading required package: sp
Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘INLA’ in rbind(info, getNamespaceInfo(env, "S3methods")):
 number of columns of matrices must match (see arg 2)
In addition: Warning message:
package ‘INLA’ was built under R version 3.6.0

 

I have uninstalled, deleted all libraries, and reinstalled them all.   Same result.  I uninstalled R and reinstalled it.  Same result. I suspect the issue is with how the INLA package is being built.

 

But!  When I install the current testing version (19.10.06) on 3.5.3, it installs without an issue.  I’m happy to just use the testing version but wanted to alert you to the issues with the stable version.

 

Thanks,

Jonathan

 

Sent from Mail for Windows 10

reinstall all packages. Maybe there is something there.

Thanks again!
